description: Answers one waiting decision with one of its options (see list_decisions). Options that need words (notes for a change, a link) take them in `text`. This is the owner's answer, given in their name: posting, publishing, sending and spending follow the option, and the answer teaches Marsell like the owner's own. Like the owner's own press in Marsell, what it approves is never held by an agent's switch: a reply or an email goes at once, a post on its day, and only Marsell's work paused for the whole business makes it wait until that is switched back on. On a card that asks before big work, make spends its price, and each other way the card offers (another level, or another kind, such as a Short in motion graphics or as AI video) spends the price on its own option; the option to go ahead without asking spends make's price and sets the owner's own budget for that kind of work. A card is answered once: one already answered, or being answered at that moment, is refused with who answered it. A homework card is refused here, and so is the card that asks who Marsell may talk to for them and whether it goes ahead on its own: only the owner answers those, in Marsell. Work the owner handed you from Copy for your agent (a reply to post in its thread, a message to send, a reply to paste) is reported back here, one call for each one you did: the option that says it is done (posted, sent or done, named on each in the brief) with the public link of what you posted in `text` (leave `text` out for an email or a private message); skipping one stays the owner's call.

board_ids.description: For a storyboard round's "pick": the storyboards to make, from the decision's board_ids in list_decisions. Each one made spends its quote.

decision_id.description: The decision's id, from list_decisions, card_read or get_overview.

option.description: The option's key, exactly as list_decisions gives it (approve, keep, skip, later and the rest differ by card).

text.description: Words for an option that asks for them (its needs_text): the owner's notes for a change, or the public link of what you posted.
